steps.title: Navigate to the Desk
steps.narration: Open the Desk page to access hypothesis testing results.
steps.point_out: The Desk page loads with the navigation bar and Hypothesis Foundry panel visible.

steps.title: Expand the Hypothesis Foundry Panel
steps.narration: Click the Hypothesis Foundry section header to reveal the panel with epoch analysis.
steps.point_out: The panel expands, showing the era-open baseline header and available subsections.

steps.title: View the New Final Summary
steps.narration: Click to expand Final Summary. This new subsection shows the epoch's complete state at a glance—source counts, family count, freeze status, and more.
steps.point_out: The Final Summary section displays source disposition counts summing to 11, family and variant counts of zero, and freeze integrity status showing green.

steps.title: Explore Source Canonical Provenance
steps.narration: Click on a source record to expand and view its full canonical provenance. You can see the mechanism statement, audit note, direction derivation, and quoted text spans that justified its disposition.
steps.point_out: The source detail expands showing mechanism, audit note, direction derivation, comparator derivation, threshold provenance, and source hash for this record.

steps.title: Verify Sources/Compiler Still Works
steps.narration: Expand the Sources/Compiler section to confirm that the new Final Summary feature did not break existing functionality.
steps.point_out: The Sources/Compiler section renders correctly, showing that the six pre-existing subsections remain intact.

steps.title: Check All 11 Source Rows Render
steps.narration: Expand Epoch/Manifest to verify all 11 real source-disposition rows still render unchanged and intact from the real committed registry.
steps.point_out: The section lists all 11 source records with their disposition badges and lineage references displayed correctly.

steps.title: Verify Freeze/Integrity Section
steps.narration: Expand Freeze/Integrity to show that the freeze status and integrity checks render correctly alongside the new Final Summary.
steps.point_out: The Freeze/Integrity subsection displays the freeze-set validation and hash pinning information without errors.

steps.title: Confirm Runner/Checkpoint Verdicts
steps.narration: Expand Runner/Checkpoint to verify the freeze integrity verdict and exhaust completion state match what Final Summary displays. This confirms cross-subsection consistency.
steps.point_out: The Runner/Checkpoint section shows the freeze integrity verdict as green and the exhaust completion status, matching the values shown in Final Summary.
